info.title: Mappi API
info.description: The contract of both React apps and of external integrators (PRD §8).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The store page the widget is on

200.description: Bare JSON: the respondent link of the matching flow

get.summary: Newest first; an Admin sees every account's. `questionnaire_id` finds the assignation of a questionnaire.

parameters.name: questionnaire_id
parameters.description: Only the assignations of this questionnaire (the form checks the one-organization rule with it)

201.description: The respondent link and the id

get.summary:
Public (the respondent page). An anonymous caller needs the owner's plan to include assignations (429) and does
not see the description nor the answers; a console user sees only their account's (another's is 404).

put.summary: Partial. `type` cannot change; `due_date: null` clears it; the organization stays while in a project.

delete.summary: 204. Counts one "assignations" (AssignationDeleted). The respondents' answers stay.

get.summary: A, a non-owner receives an empty page. The audience by name, with each member's status and attempts.

put.summary: Approve or reject one answer of the current attempt of a complete follow-up.

post.summary: "Send for correction": 201 with the new attempt. With 502 RETRY_EMAIL_NOT_SENT the attempt already exists.

get.summary: Newest first; an Admin sees every account's.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Every word in the project's or its organization's name

get.summary: The enriched project, with the follow-ups that may join it (available_assignations).

put.summary: Partial. assignation_ids replaces the set; organization_id may only be sent unchanged.

delete.summary: 204. Its assignations are unlinked, not deleted.

200.description: Changed now (upgrade) or at the end of the period (downgrade), or a checkout
Canceled at the end of the period

post.summary: "Get in touch" about a plan: emails the sales lead to SALES_LEAD_RECIPIENTS (PRD §8.3, §7.21, D8).

get.summary: The caller's plan, usage and feature verdicts; loaded once per account by the console (PRD §10.21).

requestBody.description: The gateway's event, signed in the Stripe-Signature header

get.summary: The plans the account can buy, its current plan and what is pending in the gateway (PRD §8.3, §10.15).
P. One of customer_id or questionnaire_id is required (400 if both are missing); only customer_id is used.
get.description:
`website` is only filled in for a console user of that account (the Customization screen reads it back); an
anonymous caller always gets null.

post.summary:
AG, Cap(styles). 202 {job} (job_type "styles", stages reading_website → designing_styles → saving). The job
counts one "styles" when it completes; a failed job counts nothing (§7.2).

get.summary: Every video (or one language), by order and then title.

put.summary: Full replacement: the same body as POST.

get.summary: Sorted by order and then by title. Without ?language, both languages.

post.summary:
P. Job `prompt_questionnaire`; result {type: "prompt_questionnaire", questionnaire_id} (the generated stage, a
child of the chain's root with origin_session_id = session_id).

404.description: QUESTIONNAIRE_NOT_FOUND, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, PROMPT_NOT_FOUND (no further stage to generate)

post.summary:
P. Job `linkedin_questionnaire`; result {type: "linkedin_questionnaire", questionnaire_id}, a diagnostic owned
by the configured account (LINKEDIN_OWNER_CUSTOMER_ID).

200.description: If the account exists, a recovery code is on its way.

patch.summary:
AG; a non-Admin only on their own account (another account is 404). Cap(profile) unless only the language
changes; ProfileEdited counts "profile" (§7.2).

post.summary: AG, Cap(users): a user with a permanent password and an assignable role; counts "users" (UserCreated).

get.summary: A. The account's active keys, newest first, without their secret.

post.summary: A, write permission, Feat(api). The plaintext key is in this response only.

201.description: The new key, shown only once

429.description: PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED (the plan does not include api)

delete.summary: A, write permission, Own. Revokes (204); the key stops working at once.

404.description: API_KEY_NOT_FOUND (also another account's or an already revoked key)

get.summary: X-API-Key, Cap(api). The account's questionnaires, newest first; page_size default 50, at most 50.
X-API-Key, Cap(api). A questionnaire's sessions with their answers (§7.14 format), newest first.
A. The account's webhooks, oldest first.

post.summary: A, write permission, Feat(webhook). event_type and method default to questionnaire.completed and POST.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR (url not https, unknown event_type or method)

429.description: PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED (the plan does not include webhook)

put.summary: A, write permission, Own. Partial: only the fields sent change.

delete.summary: A, write permission, Own. 204; its delivery log goes too.

get.summary: A, Own. The latest 20 deliveries, newest first (D19: the delivery log).
A job's state, polled by both apps (PRD §8.5). Public: its id is unguessable.
Bare. The caller's organizations with their members, newest first; an Admin sees every account's.

put.summary: Partial (at least one field). organization_users, when sent, is reconciled: by id, then email, then name + phone.

delete.summary: 204. Deletes the members too (D2). Counts one "organizations" (OrganizationDeleted).

404.description: FLOW_NOT_FOUND (also when the questionnaire is assigned and was looked up by slug or flow id)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Every word must appear in the title

200.description: The chain's prompts in order, with their text

get.summary:
The responses of a questionnaire, newest first, a cursor page at a time (PRD §8.4, §10.8). Any console user of
the account; another tenant's id is 404.

parameters.name: assignations_id
parameters.description: Only the sessions of this assignation (the Sheets export of an assignation).

get.summary:
One response of the questionnaire (or of one of its generated stages) with its results: the answer detail's
fallback when the session chain is not available (PRD §10.8).

The dashboard layout. The first request has the LLM choose it (once, stored forever; counts one "dashboards");
without a stored dashboard and without dashboards capacity it answers 200 with locked and no charts.
The data behind the charts (PRD §10.9), computed from the stored sessions. Counts one "analytics".
The general analytics of a questionnaire (PRD §8.4). Counts one "analytics" (AnalyticsFetched).
An ephemeral secret for one recording (~1 min, §13.4). P, rate limited.

502.description: INTERNAL_ERROR (the provider did not issue one)

post.summary:
A signed upload. answer_media (P): only for a session still being filled, of that account, with that question
(D4). prompt: the account's own users only (a chain prompt is written in the console).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED (a prompt upload without a console user)

403.description: FORBIDDEN (a prompt upload for another account)

post.summary: A signed download of an answer's file, for the account it belongs to (the key's first segment).

put.summary: Saves progress. In a follow-up's shared session the members' answers merge (§7.11).

post.summary:
Submits the session and runs PRD §7.7. A quiz funnel answers 202 {job} (its result has the products); every
other type answers {type, …result, cta?, layout?, result_copy?}.

202.description: The job computing the result (quiz funnel)

get.summary: The results the respondent app shows at /session/{id}/results, with the flow's cta, layout and texts.
Every stage of the chain the respondent went through, for the account's answer detail.

200.description: The new session (bare, without the envelope)

get.summary: PRD §8.14: data = the checks; 200 "ok" or 500 "error".

200.description: The questionnaire, with the diagnostic merged into on_completed

parent.description: "ROOT" or the id of the chain's root questionnaire

answer.title: The answer as text (option labels, "7 / 10", file names); null when unanswered.

current_question.title: Follow-ups: the first answerable question not answered or skipped; null when none is left.

description.title: Internal note; never sent to the respondent page.

attempt.title: The current attempt (1 before anybody opens a follow-up).

audience.title: {type: all | members | area | role, values: string[]}

questions.title: the registration slide (respondent login): at least one question

current_question.title: 1-based; null when every question is answered or skipped.

due_date.title: Its own due date, or the project's.

project_id.title: This project's id when it already belongs to it, else null.

active_until.title: The last day of the plan window (YYYY-MM-DD).

styles.description: logoUrl, font, body, h1–h3, p, label, a, button.primary/secondary, input (PRD §6.18)

website.description: The website the styles were read from: only for a console user of that account, else null
The website to read the brand from; empty or null = none

styles.description: Partial styles (PRD §6.18), deep-merged over the stored ones when the website did not change

questionnaire_id.title: The parent: the chain's root questionnaire (or one of its stages).

language.title: en or es; any other value becomes es.

value.description: A string, a number or a list, by control type (PRD §7.14)

next_attempt_at.title: When the next retry is due (pending only).

parent.description: "ROOT" or the id of the chain's root questionnaire

slug.description: Empty: generated from the title. ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, unique across the system
Empty: generated from the title. ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, unique across the system

s3_path.description: The key of the text in object storage: prompts/{customer_id}/{uuid}.txt

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass it back as ?cursor= for the next page. null on the last page.
